name: Daily chores
description: A checklist of the household's chores that starts again every morning. Tap a chore to tick it off; a bar shows how far the day got and the last days' bars sit at the bottom. Write the chores in the scene's settings or tap Edit on the frame, one a line: "Water the plants @mon,thu" for the days a chore is due (@weekdays and @weekends work too) and "Dishes #Sam" for who does it, shown as a tag or, with Group by person on, as Sam's own list. Set the hour the day starts (4 = 04:00), and whether tomorrow's chores show once today's are done. On a frame with buttons, forward ticks the next chore and back takes the last tick back. High contrast on black-and-white and grey panels, or always with the Contrast setting.
